We’re a location-based photography team — we don’t have a walk-in studio space. Our shoots are done on location or at the client’s venue.

Capturing life's most precious moments since 1993, The Photogenic Studio by Ajit Rane brings a blend of classic, candid, and cinematic storytelling to every event. Specializing in weddings, corporate events, and celebrations of all kinds, our dedicated team of photographers and videographers serves clients across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Pune. We go beyond traditional photography, offering on-location shoots, video production, and engaging photo booth services to bring your vision to life.

We also provide Photobooth, Birthday Decor, LED, Audio setups service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m a student from Sir J. J. Institute of Applied Art, and this was my first and last visit to Colo Colors.

I went there at 10:00 AM to print my campaign project and received my prints only at 2:00 PM, an unacceptable delay for basic printing work. Even worse, the staff clearly lacks basic knowledge of professional printing. They had no idea about Indigo sheets, acrylic sheets, and didn’t even have a proper A4-size printer for regular Xerox.

After waiting for hours, while collecting my prints I noticed they had forgotten to print 6 images. On top of that, 1.5 hours after submission, they informed me that their printer wasn’t working and forced me to print on a random textured sheet, completely ruining the output. The print quality was poor, colors were inaccurate, and they don’t even have an RGB printer.

The color values were completely off, and the overall print quality was extremely low. totally unacceptable for anyone working in art, design, or photography.

🛑🛑🛑If you respect your work, whether it’s artwork, photography, or any serious project, do not come here. This place is a waste of time, money, and effort.🛑🛑🛑
